requirements.quote:
Event 19: BGPOpen

         Definition: An event is generated when a valid OPEN message has
                     been received.

         Status:     Mandatory
requirements.condition: A valid OPEN message has been received.
requirements.why_checkable: Valid OPEN input can be correlated with the generated FSM event.

requirements.quote:
Optional
         Attribute
         Status:     1) The DelayOpen optional attribute SHOULD be set
                        to FALSE.
requirements.required_behavior: The DelayOpen optional attribute SHOULD be set to FALSE.
requirements.why_checkable: The optional attribute value associated with BGPOpen is observable.

requirements.quote: 2) The DelayOpenTimer SHOULD not be running.
requirements.required_behavior: The DelayOpenTimer SHOULD not be running.
requirements.why_checkable: Timer state associated with BGPOpen is observable.

requirements.quote:
Event 20: BGPOpen with DelayOpenTimer running

         Definition: An event is generated when a valid OPEN message has
                     been received for a peer that has a successfully
                     established transport connection and is currently
                     delaying the sending of a BGP open message.

         Status:     Optional
requirements.condition: Optional event 20 is supported, and a valid OPEN is received for a peer with a successfully established transport connection while sending the BGP OPEN is being delayed.
requirements.required_behavior: Generate event 20, BGPOpen with DelayOpenTimer running.
requirements.why_checkable: The OPEN input, transport state, delayed-send state, and selected FSM event can be checked together.

requirements.quote:
Optional
         Attribute
         Status:     1) The DelayOpen attribute SHOULD be set to TRUE.
requirements.condition: For optional event 20, BGPOpen with DelayOpenTimer running.
requirements.required_behavior: The DelayOpen attribute SHOULD be set to TRUE.
requirements.why_checkable: DelayOpen configuration for the optional event can be inspected.

requirements.condition: For optional event 20, BGPOpen with DelayOpenTimer running.
requirements.why_checkable: The timer running state for the optional event can be observed.

requirements.quote:
Event 21: BGPHeaderErr

         Definition: An event is generated when a received BGP message
                     header is not valid.

         Status:     Mandatory
requirements.condition: A received BGP message header is invalid.
requirements.why_checkable: An invalid header can be supplied and the resulting FSM event observed.

requirements.quote:
Event 22: BGPOpenMsgErr

         Definition: An event is generated when an OPEN message has been
                     received with errors.

         Status:     Mandatory
requirements.condition: An OPEN message has been received with errors.
requirements.why_checkable: An erroneous OPEN can be correlated with its generated error event.

requirements.quote:
Event 23: OpenCollisionDump

         Definition: An event generated administratively when a
                     connection collision has been detected while
                     processing an incoming OPEN message and this



Rekhter, et al.             Standards Track                    [Page 49]

RFC 4271                         BGP-4                      January 2006


                     connection has been selected to be disconnected.
                     See Section 6.8 for more information on collision
                     detection.

                     Event 23 is an administrative action generated by
                     implementation logic that determines whether this
                     connection needs to be dropped per the rules in
                     Section 6.8.  This event may occur if the FSM is
                     implemented as two linked state machines.

         Status:     Optional
requirements.condition: Optional OpenCollisionDump handling is supported, a connection collision is detected during processing of an incoming OPEN, and this connection is selected for disconnection under the collision rules referenced in Section 6.8.
requirements.required_behavior: Generate administrative event 23, OpenCollisionDump, through implementation logic determining that this connection must be dropped.
requirements.why_checkable: The collision-selection outcome and administrative event generation can be inspected together.

requirements.quote:
Optional
         Attribute
         Status:     If the state machine is to process this event in
                     the Established state,
                     1) CollisionDetectEstablishedState optional
                        attribute SHOULD be set to TRUE.
requirements.condition: The state machine is to process OpenCollisionDump in the Established state.
requirements.required_behavior: The CollisionDetectEstablishedState optional attribute SHOULD be set to TRUE.
requirements.why_checkable: The Established-state event handling and optional attribute value can be checked.

requirements.quote:
Please note: The OpenCollisionDump event can occur
                     in Idle, Connect, Active, OpenSent, and OpenConfirm
                     without any optional attributes being set.
requirements.condition: The FSM is in Idle, Connect, Active, OpenSent, or OpenConfirm.
requirements.required_behavior: Permit OpenCollisionDump to occur without any optional attributes being set.
requirements.why_checkable: Event acceptance in each named state can be checked with all optional attributes unset.

requirements.quote:
Event 24: NotifMsgVerErr

         Definition: An event is generated when a NOTIFICATION message
                     with "version error" is received.

         Status:     Mandatory
requirements.condition: A NOTIFICATION message with "version error" is received.
requirements.why_checkable: A version-error NOTIFICATION can be correlated with the selected event.

requirements.quote:
Event 25: NotifMsg

         Definition: An event is generated when a NOTIFICATION message
                     is received and the error code is anything but
                     "version error".

         Status:     Mandatory
requirements.condition: A NOTIFICATION message is received whose error code is anything other than "version error".
requirements.why_checkable: Other NOTIFICATION error codes can be checked for selection of NotifMsg.

requirements.quote:
Event 26: KeepAliveMsg

         Definition: An event is generated when a KEEPALIVE message is
                     received.

         Status:     Mandatory
requirements.why_checkable: Receipt of KEEPALIVE and its emitted FSM event can be checked.

requirements.quote:
Event 27: UpdateMsg

         Definition: An event is generated when a valid UPDATE message
                     is received.

         Status:     Mandatory
requirements.condition: A valid UPDATE message is received.
requirements.why_checkable: A valid UPDATE can be correlated with UpdateMsg generation.

requirements.quote:
Event 28: UpdateMsgErr

         Definition: An event is generated when an invalid UPDATE
                     message is received.

         Status:     Mandatory
requirements.condition: An invalid UPDATE message is received.
requirements.why_checkable: An invalid UPDATE can be correlated with UpdateMsgErr generation.
